# HOOPS24 — NBA Trivia Minigames

> Free daily NBA trivia minigames: NBA Wordle, guess-the-player (Who Are Ya), stat grids, starting-five builders, connections, heatmaps and more. Play solo or online against friends, earn points per correct answer and climb the global leaderboard.

## What you can do here

- Play 17+ NBA trivia minigames in the browser, no install needed
- Create a free account to keep score, earn ranks and appear on the leaderboard
- Play multiplayer matches against friends via a shareable room
- Games rotate daily with fresh NBA data (players, teams, stats, draft history)

## Games

- [All games](/): the landing page lists every playable game
- [NBA Wordle](/wordle): guess the mystery player in 8 tries from attribute clues
- [Who Are Ya](/who-are-ya): name the player from a blurred photo that sharpens each miss
- [Guess the MVP](/guess-mvps): identify MVP winners season by season
- [Starting Five](/starting-five): fill a team's historic starting lineup
- [Series Winner](/series-winner): pick playoff series winners
- [Name the Logo](/name-logo): recognize NBA club logos

## Notes

- The app is a single-page React application; game content loads dynamically.
- /admin is a private administration area.
